# FrameXML mixins and utility tables

Global tables defined by Blizzard's UI code. Mixins are applied with `Mixin(obj, FooMixin)`, `CreateFromMixins(FooMixin)` or `mixin="FooMixin"` in XML. Parameters are as written in the source.
